data.body: PAUSE DISPOSITION after the completed >1s audit. The measured opportunity remains about 75s projected macOS wall / 207 aggregate runner-seconds. pytest, pip, Poetry, and pre-commit are 4/4 consensus against per-test source-checkout Git subprocesses, but there is still no consensus fidelity-preserving primitive for rebar's stronger attribution contract: adding a Git library expands dependency/install risk; hand-parsing symbolic, packed, detached, linked-worktree, and future reftable state is unsafe; removing the per-test guard weakens coverage. No implementation is automatically approved. Move to blocked so this is not represented as active work; unblock only on an explicit operator design choice or new evidence for a safe primitive.
